name: SK Hynix
day_summary: SK Hynix plunged 7.54% to ₩2,048,000 — the second wave of heavy selling this week, following Monday's KOSPI circuit-breaker session. Today's catalysts: Broadcom's 14% single-session crash on stale AI guidance, a hot CPI print driving the dollar higher and the won weaker, and Trump pledging fresh Iran airstrikes. The VKOSPI fear index hit a record high. Bears dominated; the HBM thesis is intact but the tape is in full risk-off.

short_pnl: +7.54% — Broadcom/CPI/Iran triple trigger paid shorts handsomely

decision.rationale: Downgrade from BUY to HOLD. The HBM supply story is unchanged — SK Hynix is still NVIDIA's sole advanced HBM supplier, Blackwell/Rubin demand is intact, and the HBM cycle remains multi-year. But the market does not distinguish right now: Broadcom's AI-spend doubt, a won at ₩1,548/USD, record VKOSPI fear, and $62B+ in cumulative foreign KOSPI outflows mean the near-term tape is toxic. HOLD: if you own it, do not panic-sell a fundamentally sound business into panic. Do not add until (1) USD/KRW stabilizes below ₩1,500, (2) Broadcom's miss is clearly dissociated from HBM demand in the market's mind, and (3) FOMC June 17 resolves without a rate-hike signal. A recovery above ₩2,200,000 resets the add trigger. A break below ₩1,900,000 risks a deeper re-test of the circuit-breaker lows near ₩1,800,000.

positioning.short_interest: Foreign-owned ~54% of float — the marginal seller in today's session
positioning.notable_flow: Foreign institutions were aggressive net sellers of SK Hynix alongside the broader KOSPI, which has now seen an estimated $62B+ in cumulative foreign outflows since end-May (Goldman Sachs estimate). The VKOSPI fear index hit a record high, suggesting panic-selling and forced unwinds rather than fundamental repositioning. With 54% foreign ownership, a weaker won at ₩1,548/USD compounds losses for dollar-denominated holders — every 1% won move is an additional 1% hit to returns, independent of the stock.

what_traders_are_doing: Desks are in damage-control mode. The market is treating every AI-chip name as guilty by association with Broadcom — even though SK Hynix's HBM is structurally different from Broadcom's networking ASICs. The dominant trade right now is forced selling: FX hedges being unwound as the won breaks toward ₩1,550, margin calls triggered by the second major KOSPI selloff in a week, and global risk-off flows rotating out of all Korean equities. The bull case (HBM is the only memory that fits in NVIDIA's GPUs, supply is tight, demand is inelastic) has not changed — but no one is stepping in to buy until the FX and FOMC uncertainty clears. The watchword is: right thesis, wrong tape.

analysis:
## When the wrong domino falls on the right business

SK Hynix did nothing wrong today. Its HBM technology lead is intact, NVIDIA's Blackwell/Rubin demand is undiminished, and memory pricing power is the strongest in a decade. Yet the stock fell 7.54% — because [Broadcom cratered 14%](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/06/08/the-ishares-korea-etf-ewy-dropped-14-in-its-most-brutal-session-in-six-years-and-it-started-with-broadcom/).

The distinction matters: **Broadcom makes custom networking ASICs** for hyperscalers (Google TPUs, Amazon Trainium) — a market segment that competes with NVIDIA's merchant GPUs. When Broadcom signals its 2027 AI revenue is not accelerating, it is saying that Google and Amazon's *custom build* programs have plateaued. It says nothing about whether those same companies are still buying NVIDIA's Blackwell accelerators — and all evidence says they are, in volume, including the HBM that goes into every Blackwell chip.

But in a risk-off tape with the [VKOSPI at a record high](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/more/261957743-samsung-skhynix-japan-hbm-kospi-tradingkey), the market does not make such distinctions.

## The FX overlay

With [54% of SK Hynix's float held by foreign investors](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/08/kospi-sk-hynix-samsung-electronics-why-foreign-investors-are-selling.html) and USD/KRW now at **₩1,548** (up from ₩1,392 at the start of this sell-off cycle), the stock is functioning as much as a currency trade as a semiconductor one. [Goldman Sachs estimates $62B+ in cumulative foreign KOSPI outflows since end-May](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/08/kospi-sk-hynix-samsung-electronics-why-foreign-investors-are-selling.html). Every step the won takes weaker adds to that exit pressure, regardless of what HBM pricing is doing.

## The trade going forward

Two gates need to clear before the BUY case re-engages:

1. **FOMC June 17**: A hawkish surprise (rate hike signal) pushes USD/KRW past ₩1,570 and triggers another foreign-selling leg. A hold or dovish shade flips the won and makes SK Hynix a high-beta short-squeeze candidate off extreme oversold readings.

2. **AI demand clarity**: A data point that explicitly dissociates HBM demand from Broadcom's custom-chip narrative — ideally from NVIDIA's own management or hyperscaler capex commentary.

Until then: HOLD. The business is worth owning; the tape is not worth fighting.
